result.emptyBody: Choose an AI music model, voice cloner, or sound generator. Modify variables on the left and craft your next high-fidelity track.

suno-create-music.name: Suno Create Music
suno-create-music.description: Suno generates music that turns text prompts into full songs — complete with vocals, lyrics, and instrumentation. Describe a mood, genre, or specific lyric idea, and Suno creates a realistic, studio-quality track in seconds.

suno-remix-music.name: Suno Remix Music
suno-remix-music.description: Remix and rearrange existing audio tracks with new styles and prompts to create brand-new musical arrangements.

suno-extend-music.name: Suno Extend Music
suno-extend-music.description: Seamlessly extend and continue existing audio tracks from any specified timestamp.

suno-generate-sounds.name: Suno Generate Sounds
suno-generate-sounds.description: Create realistic sound effects, ambient atmospheres, transition sounds, and rhythm loops from text descriptions.

suno-add-vocals.name: Suno Add Vocals
suno-add-vocals.description: Add expressive, natural-sounding vocal tracks and singing over an existing instrumental track.

suno-generate-mashup.name: Suno Generate Mashup
suno-generate-mashup.description: Blend and mash up multiple audio tracks into a cohesive, creative musical fusion.

suno-add-instrumental.name: Suno Add Instrumental
suno-add-instrumental.description: Generate full instrumental backing arrangements for raw vocal recordings or audio snippets.

suno-voice-clone.name: Suno Voice Cloning
suno-voice-clone.description: Clone and extract vocal personas from uploaded audio to use in custom music generation.

minimax-voice-clone.name: Minimax Voice Clone
minimax-voice-clone.description: High-accuracy voice replication with automatic background noise reduction and volume normalization.

minimax-speech-2.6-hd.name: Minimax Speech HD
minimax-speech-2.6-hd.description: Flagship high-definition multilingual text-to-speech with expressive emotions, pitch, and speed adjustments.

minimax-speech-2.6-turbo.name: Minimax Speech Turbo
minimax-speech-2.6-turbo.description: Ultra-low latency speech synthesis optimized for real-time conversational agents and long-form voice generation.

mmaudio-v2-text-to-audio.name: MM Audio V2
mmaudio-v2-text-to-audio.description: Advanced multimodal audio synthesis that turns textual descriptions into high-fidelity soundscapes and audio effects.

elevenlabs-text-to-dialogue-v3.name: ElevenLabs Text to Dialogue V3
elevenlabs-text-to-dialogue-v3.description: Multi-speaker theatrical dialogue generation with distinct persona voices and dramatic nuances.

suno-convert-to-wav.name: Suno Convert to WAV
suno-convert-to-wav.description: Convert generated Suno audio tracks to lossless studio-grade WAV format.

gemini-3-1-flash-tts.name: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS
gemini-3-1-flash-tts.description: Google Gemini next-generation Flash speech engine with natural pacing, multi-turn dialogue, and vivid expression.

gemini-2-5-pro-tts.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro TTS
gemini-2-5-pro-tts.description: Google Gemini 2.5 Pro studio-grade neural voice synthesis designed for audiobooks and cinematic narration.

elevenlabs-tts-turbo-2-5.name: ElevenLabs TTS Turbo 2.5
elevenlabs-tts-turbo-2-5.description: Industry-leading lifelike speech synthesis with ultra-fast generation and fine-grained voice stability control.

minimax-music-3.0.name: MiniMax Music 3.0
minimax-music-3.0.description: Generate full songs with vocals or instrumental tracks from text prompts and structured lyrics.

suno-v4.name: Suno v4
suno-v4.description: Suno v4 turns text prompts into full studio-mastered songs with vocals, lyrics, and instrumentation.

suno-v3.5.name: Suno v3.5
suno-v3.5.description: Suno v3.5 synthesizes pop-ready tracks from text prompts with vocals, lyrics, and instrumentation.

prompt.title: Lyrics / Prompt
prompt.description: Text prompt describing desired audio content or exact lyrics to be sung in the track.
prompt.placeholder: Enter what you want generated or type your lyrics here...
prompt.example: Hard-hitting rap track with aggressive beat and confident male vocals about winning.

style.title: Music Style
style.description: Music style specification for the generated audio.
style.placeholder: Jazz, Classical, Electronic, Pop, Rock, Hip-hop, etc.

model.title: Model Version
model.description: The AI model version to use for generation.

custom_mode.title: Custom Mode
custom_mode.description: Enable custom mode for advanced settings.

title.title: Track Title
title.description: Title for the generated music track (optional).

persona_id.title: Persona ID
persona_id.description: Persona ID or custom voice ID to apply to the generated music (optional).

persona_model.title: Persona Model Type
persona_model.description: Select persona model type (style or voice persona).

instrumental.title: Instrumental Only
instrumental.description: Generate purely instrumental music without vocals or sung lyrics.

negative_tags.title: Negative Tags
negative_tags.description: Music styles or traits to exclude from the generated audio (optional).

style_weight.title: Style Weight
style_weight.description: Influence weight of the specified musical style (0 to 1).

audio_weight.title: Audio Weight
audio_weight.description: Weight of source audio reference in remix or continuation.

audio_url.title: Audio File
audio_url.description: Upload or provide an audio URL to use as reference.

continue_at.title: Continue At (seconds)
continue_at.description: Exact timestamp in seconds from which to extend the track.

sound_loop.title: Seamless Loop
sound_loop.description: Generate an audio track that loops seamlessly.

sound_tempo.title: Tempo (BPM)
sound_tempo.description: Tempo specification in beats per minute.

sound_key.title: Musical Key
sound_key.description: Musical key and scale for the generated sound (e.g. C Major, A Minor).

grab_lyrics.title: Extract Lyrics
grab_lyrics.description: Extract and retain sung lyrics from the input audio.

audios_list.title: Audio Track List
audios_list.description: List of audio tracks to combine into a mashup.

tags.title: Style Tags
tags.description: Tags describing musical genre, mood, and instruments.

voice_name.title: Voice Name
voice_name.description: Custom name for the cloned voice profile.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of voice profile or musical style.

vocal_start_s.title: Vocal Start Time (s)
vocal_start_s.description: Start position of vocal sample in seconds.

vocal_end_s.title: Vocal End Time (s)
vocal_end_s.description: End position of vocal sample in seconds.

need_noise_reduction.title: Noise Reduction
need_noise_reduction.description: Filter background noise from uploaded voice recordings.

voice_id.title: Preset Voice / Speaker
voice_id.description: Select a curated speaker profile for voice synthesis.

speed.title: Speech Speed
speed.description: Speed multiplier for speech synthesis (1.0 is normal speed).

english_normalization.title: English Normalization
english_normalization.description: Enhance text normalization for numbers, symbols, and dates in English.

bitrate.title: Bitrate (bps)
bitrate.description: Audio bitrate in bits per second.

language_boost.title: Language Boost
language_boost.description: Enhance speech clarity and dialect recognition for selected language.

duration.title: Duration (seconds)
duration.description: Length of generated audio in seconds.

dialogue.title: Dialogue Script
dialogue.description: Multi-turn conversational script for speech synthesis.

stability.title: Voice Stability
stability.description: Voice consistency and delivery stability (0 to 1).

similarity_boost.title: Similarity Boost
similarity_boost.description: Enhance vocal similarity and character fidelity.

language_code.title: Language Code
language_code.description: Target language ISO code for speech synthesis.

task_id.title: Task ID
task_id.description: Task identifier from a previous generation to convert.

audio_id.title: Audio ID
audio_id.description: Specific audio track identifier to convert.

speakers.title: Speakers
speakers.description: Configured character voices for dialogue generation.

sample_context.title: Sample Context / Tone
sample_context.description: Overall narration tone, delivery style, and context.

lyrics.title: Structured Lyrics
lyrics.description: Lyrics text with line breaks and optional instrumental section markers.
lyrics.example:
Walking through the neon lights
We are shining, we are free

is_instrumental.title: Instrumental Only
is_instrumental.description: Generate purely instrumental music with no vocals.
